title: Stable email identities and inbox pagination/polling
diagnosis: Confirmed legacy and native copies of the same acknowledgement/rejection differ only by URLs appended by the newer HTML parser; accepted legacy rejection resurfaced as an unreviewed native copy. Polling currently rebuilds identical list/pagination DOM every 15 seconds.
steps: Add canonical duplicate pointers and provider/RFC identity aliases without deleting source evidence
Reconcile only unique full-content legacy/native matches, preserving decisions, analysis and true receipt metadata
Treat distinct native IDs and changed outcomes as distinct messages; prevent duplicate review or analysis
Avoid unchanged inbox DOM replacement, preserve expanded source messages and clamp stale page offsets
Verify identity/decision/ambiguity and browser stability scenarios; deploy and inspect only safe aggregate/identity metadata
